top_choice_rationale: P001 (GLP-1 physiology and active form: Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is the only shortlisted discovery where the mechanism is complete, independently replicated and confirmed by large randomized outcome trials, and its open issues (Mojsov priority versus the Habener group, exclusion of Knudsen) concern attribution rather than whether the discovery is real. The citation limited to physiology and the active peptide bounds that risk. A further delay is hard to defend, so an award is preferable to no award.
